name: Kinetic Tech Incident
summary: Editorial kinetic documentary: near-black stage, oversized Poppins display, one accent per act, evidence panels, restrained ambient texture, dedicated 16:9 recomposition and a 4:5 cover.
useWhen: Default for business, technology, incident, lesson, founder and product films. Use unless the brief asks for the bright retail Walmart look.

voice.note: Only SD_VOICE_03 — Nathan Cole is permitted.

core.palette: near-black graphite stage; cyan setup, orange warning, red failure, green recovery; one accent per act; max two accents per frame.
core.typography: Poppins 600/700/800 display; SF Mono micro labels; no more than three type sizes per scene.
core.layout: 76px vertical side margin; 96px wide side margin; statement left / evidence right in 16:9; 1px 11% white panel borders.
core.motion: 0.7s mask-line headline; 0.055-0.09s word stagger; 1.8-2.5% camera push; held final frame; no bounce on type.
core.spine: hook -> experiment -> data -> warning -> failure -> recovery -> lesson -> conclusion.
